description: This Java source file defines the ADTA28Handler class, which processes HL7 ADT A28 messages (Patient Re-Admit/Update) using HAPI HL7 library within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It handles message validation, patient creation, and identifier extraction, and is part of the HL7 message handling infrastructure in OpenMRS.

classes.name: ADTA28Handler
classes.description: HL7 application class handling ADT A28 messages for OpenMRS

methods.name: canProcess
methods.description: Checks if the message is an ADT_A28 message for processing

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Main method to process the ADT A28 HL7 message

methods.name: processADT_A28
methods.description: Processes the specific ADT A28 message, creates patients as needed

methods.name: findPatientId
methods.description: Resolves patient ID from PID segment

methods.name: createPatient
methods.description: Creates a new Patient object from PID segment and saves it

methods.name: getMSH
methods.description: Retrieves the MSH segment from the message

methods.name: getPID
methods.description: Retrieves the PID segment from the message

methods.name: tsToDate
methods.description: Converts HL7 TS data type to Java Date
